skill.summary: Track and manage wedding guest RSVPs, meal preferences, plus-ones, accessibility needs, seating, reminders, and final headcount exports.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Wedding Guest RSVP Command Center.

- Provides organized templates to track RSVP status, meal choices, plus-ones, and accessibility needs.
- Includes tools for managing seating constraints and VIP tables.
- Offers reminder message drafts for pending RSVPs.
- Generates a ready-to-export final headcount summary for caterers and venues.
- No direct communication features; all data entry and outreach handled by the user.
